name: Taxila
description: Taxila is a cluster of ancient ruins about 25 km northwest of Islamabad, in Pakistan's Punjab. Walk from a Neolithic mound to the walled grid of Sirkap and the later city of Sirsukh, and you can trace a crossroads town shaped by Persian, Greek and Central Asian rulers. It was also a major Buddhist centre of learning, and its monasteries and stupas still dot the hills.
